verdict.rationale: Consensus documents one genuine bulk operation: importing thousands of papers into the Library in one click from Zotero, BibTeX, PDF or RIS. Deep Search and literature-review features analyze many studies at once, but they are synthesis features rather than bulk actions on a user's items. Missing for 10: bulk edit, tag, organize or delete actions on library items; batch or bulk endpoints in the REST API or MCP server; documentation of limits or behavior for bulk actions; hands-on or independent corroboration.
